notes: Assertions graded by ../../../../tmp scratch grade.py; the mtime-trap check is the load-bearing one. Ground truth (2026-09-06): 39 sessions, 7 projects, 392 agents, span 2026-07-10..2026-09-06. Dormant projects: game-flood (08-03), ma-splitflap (08-04), c5017f (07-25), claude-aquarium (07-25).

evals.name: month-scoped-overview
evals.prompt: 8月って何やってたんだっけ？プロジェクト横断で見せて
evals.expected_output: August-only view grouped by project, using internal timestamps (not mtime), with agent counts as the weight signal.
assertions: Restricts to August rather than dumping everything since July
Does not attribute September activity to a project that stopped earlier (the mtime trap)
Conveys relative weight per project via agent or session counts
Names only projects that actually exist

evals.name: cross-project-topic-search
evals.prompt: splitflap のトランジションまわり、どのセッションでやったか探して
evals.expected_output: Identifies session 6329b45a (ma-splitflap, feat-board-transition) as the real match, distinguishes same-branch-but-unrelated sessions, surfaces the claude-tower cross-project echo, and reports what the work concluded.
assertions: Shows the evidence (turn or agent brief) that justified each match
Gives session ids or enough info to open them
Does not invent sessions or misattribute findings

evals.name: what-to-resume
evals.prompt: 最近さわってないプロジェクトある？そろそろ再開したいので全体の状況教えて
evals.expected_output: Global map ordered by weight with per-project dormancy from real last-activity dates, plus a grounded recommendation.
assertions: Explicitly identifies dormant projects and how long
Bases dormancy on in-file timestamps, not mtime
Gives a usable recommendation grounded in the data
No invented projects, dates, or activity
